infobox.usage: Unlocks a room on the second floor of the garage at the blue chalet on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: USEC cottage room key (USEC cott.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the rooms in the cottages of former USEC operatives.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: The room can also be entered through the window by climbing on the canopy from any second floor window, not requiring this key.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: This key unlocks a room that is located on the second floor of the garage at the blue chalet on Lighthouse.
